canonical_project: Southern Energy Big Data Center (CSG Digital Industry Eco-Park)
notes: Groundbreaking 2023-06-17 in Gui'an New Area; total investment RMB 1.45 bn, ~133.8 mu, total plan ~5,000 x 10kW racks hosting ~100,000 1U servers, PUE <=1.2; phase 1 ~RMB 800 mn for 2,000 x 10kW racks, 3-5 yr build. Part of China Southern Power Grid digital industry ecosystem park. Capacity 50 MW = 5,000 racks x 10 kW (total plan).
